questions.question: Distinguish Zermelo’s 1908 axiom system, the later ZF system and modern ZFC; do not claim a proof of ZFC’s consistency, and note that the axiom of choice was included in Zermelo’s 1908 system.

localizations.source: Distinguish Zermelo’s 1908 axiom system, the later ZF system and modern ZFC; do not claim a proof of ZFC’s consistency, and note that the axiom of choice was included in Zermelo’s 1908 system.
localizations.ru: Различить систему аксиом Цермело 1908 года, последующую ZF и современную ZFC; не утверждать доказанную непротиворечивость ZFC и отметить, что аксиома выбора входила в систему Цермело 1908 года.

questions.resolution: The wording was corrected: Zermelo’s 1908 system is distinguished from the later ZF and ZFC systems, the axiom of choice is identified as part of the 1908 system, and the claim that ZFC’s consistency has been proved was removed. Verified against the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy.
